title: [vercel/next.js] Fix issue #96555: `defineConfig` in `next/experimental/testmode/playwright` does not allow overriding default `projects`
description:
Fix GitHub issue #96555 in vercel/next.js:
https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/96555

Repo:
https://github.com/vercel/next.js

Target:
Address the bug where `defineConfig` in `next/experimental/testmode/playwright` fails to override the default Playwright `projects` list, causing extra browsers to run. Land a focused upstream fix.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change upstream against vercel/next.js.
- An upstream pull request linked to issue #96555.
- Testing notes covering the relevant fix or regression coverage.
- The final OpenJobs submission must include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- The PR must clearly reference the GitHub issue URL above.

Do not submit analysis only. Submit code plus the upstream PR.

Concrete PR mention requirement for this listing: mention openjobs.bot and 2c7a6430-f65e-49aa-a455-338f2063643a or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/2c7a6430-f65e-49aa-a455-338f2063643a in the PR body or linked issue comment.
